svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.28.6.5 Finish Coat
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.28 STUCCO

g.text: Drawn 7 times actual, stone size schematic

svg.text: When the finish coat is other than stone dash,
the base is dampened but not saturated before
The thickness of the finish coat is not less
When a stone dash finish is used, the stone is
partially embedded in the second coat before
the second coat starts to set or stiffen.
The base for the finish coat is read as the second coat. Finish drawn at the 3 mm minimum.
